description:
Sou Jeovani Sanda, de Luanda, apaixonado por ciência. Quero ser físico teórico e escrever as minhas próprias leis sobre o universo. Acredito que talento sem conhecimento não faz a humanidade avançar.

Interesses: xadrez, física quântica e astrofísica. Aprendo rápido e tenho altas habilidades.

Na minha equipa, o conhecimento vem primeiro, depois o trabalho em conjunto. Duas cabeças pensam melhor que uma.

Procuro pessoas dedicadas, que arriscam tudo, capazes e que dominam o que fazem.
summary:
Space Exploration Museum is an educational virtual museum designed to make space exploration more accessible, interactive, and engaging. Through five digital rooms, visitors discover the history of space missions, equipment left behind on the Moon, robotic exploration of Mars, and the scientific legacy of space discoveries. The experience concludes with an interactive quiz that allows visitors to test their knowledge.

Our project addresses the challenge by transforming scientific information into an organized and accessible learning experience, combining historical facts, NASA mission images, educational explanations, and interactive activities.

The museum is important because it encourages scientific curiosity, promotes space education, and inspires young people to explore science, technology, and the Universe. It demonstrates that even when a mission ends, its discoveries continue to contribute to humanity's knowledge.
details: Project Details Space Exploration Museum The Space Exploration Museum is an educational virtual experience that allows visitors to explore space missions and scientific discoveries through five digital rooms. The museum is organized as a guided journey, beginning with an introduction to space exploration and continuing through different topics. How it works: Visitors navigate through the museum using links and interactive navigation elements. Room 1 introduces the experience, Room 2 presents equipment left behind on the Moon, Room 3 explores robotic missions to Mars, Room 4 highlights the scientific legacy of space exploration, and Room 5 concludes with an interactive quiz to test visitors' knowledge. Benefits and intended impact: The project makes scientific information easier to explore and understand. It encourages curiosity, supports informal learning, promotes interest in astronomy and space science, and inspires young people to learn more about the Universe and humanity's achievements in space. Tools and technologies: We used Google Sites to design and publish the virtual museum, Google Forms to create the final interactive quiz, and HTML and CSS to create a customized exploration button. We also used NASA's publicly available images and multimedia resources to support the educational content. Creative aspect: Our main creative idea was to transform scientific information into a virtual museum with five connected rooms, creating an exploration experience rather than presenting information as a simple collection of pages. The final quiz adds an element of participation and knowledge assessment. Team considerations: Our team considered scientific accuracy, educational value, accessibility, clear navigation, visual organization, and visitor engagement. We aimed to create an experience that is informative, easy to navigate, and suitable for people interested in discovering space exploration.
